data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Attractions & Tickets, enter city and keyword, search, sort, open a result, view details), with matching parameters. It is slightly vague on the action: it gives "look at details (e.g. Nearby)" and omits the add-to-favorites option. The "pick from suggestions" city step is also less precise than the true one, but a browser automation could still be built from this spec.
